requirements_to_testpoints.requirement_text: 让 D6 引脚的蜂鸣器每 2 秒响 200ms。
requirements_to_testpoints.stimulus: Provide io_0 deltas advancing time in milliseconds through repeated 2s periods; e.g., start from 0 and step with small deltas totaling 2000ms then continue; verify behavior over at least two full cycles.
requirements_to_testpoints.oracle: io_1 equals 31 Hz (non-zero) for cycleAccumMs in [0,200) and equals 0 Hz for cycleAccumMs in [200,2000); this pattern repeats every 2000ms.
